notes.title: Jackal - from the creator of Maniac - Demo Available
notes.content:
[p]You're a drug-enhanced hitman with the moral compass of a broken slot machine, turning iconic Vegas hotels into impromptu abattoirs. Every table, chair, and kitchen utensil becomes a weapon in your hands because apparently, even the cutlery wants in on the action.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45421829/15964a8069976d29ebb5576f35eb85abf11974cb.png"][/img][/p][p]WATCH THE TRAILER:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/HKKExRvpKMY"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Welcome to the demo of the definitive top-down murder simulator where mobsters become meat puppets and physics is just another drug. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]PLAY THE DEMO & WISHLIST:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133310/Jackal_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]Why it Hurts So Good:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ultra-violent room redecoration[/p][/*][*][p]Rooms shift. Layouts change. No run is ever safe.[/p][/*][*][p]Chemical superpowers: faster, stronger, higher — until you crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Brutal finishers: not just endings, but punchlines.[/p][/*][*][p]Inspired by the sickest, bleediest pop-culture nightmares: [i]Hotline Miami[/i], [i]Pulp Fiction[/i], [i]Fear & Loathing in Vegas[/i].

[/p][/*][/list][p]Created by Michał Marcinkowski – the madman who gave us Soldat and clearly never learned when to stop. [i] "Jackal combines my love of John Wick fight scenes, Scorsese's mobsters, Tarantino's storytelling, and the soul of the 1970s,"[/i] says Marcinkowski, presumably while cackling maniacally.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45421829/a845cf7b4a9ab41feece115f7cab8ceacb3d9c93.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Release Info:
[/b]Play the demo now!
(A taste of the full massacre launching January 2026)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Warning:[/b] Side effects may include uncontrollable urges to redecorate with viscera, sudden appreciation for 1970s interior design, and the inexplicable need to wear sunglasses indoors.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Chaotic Evil Bundle Released!
notes.content:
The Chaotic Evil bundle is officially live and ready for you to dive into! Featuring two adrenaline-pumping games, Maniac and Fatal Zone, this bundle is a must-have for fans of chaos and destruction.

🧟‍♂️ Fatal Zone:
Step into a brutal world overrun by zombies in Fatal Zone, an auto shooter infused with roguelike and RPG elements. Exterminate zombie hordes, gather resources, upgrade your camp, and level up your mercenaries. The fate of humanity hangs in the balance—survival is in your hands!

💥 Maniac:
Ready to unleash your inner chaos? Maniac throws you into a rogue-lite crime action game where the world is against you, and your insanity drives the mayhem. Embrace the chaos, bet it all on destruction, and watch the world unravel in your wake!

The Chaotic Evil bundle is now available on both our pages. Don’t miss out—grab your copys and get ready to wreak havoc!

notes.title: Added achievements, new cities, new game modes, hard difficulty and more
notes.content:
MERRY CHRISTMAS EVERYBODY!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/bc45a2ba522fa31bd70f1c3c9555e498cf9edec0.jpg[/img]

I"VE GOT A LOT OF PRESENTS FOR YOU GOOD BOYS AND GIRLS!

[h2]57 ACHIEVEMENTS![/h2]
Check them all out in the Steam's library page.
Thanks to Banzai and neuralcrayon512 from the community for giving a lot of fun ideas!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/af9566e4e399823abc9ddcfe8f19875e7fb6517e.gif[/img]

[h2]CUSTOM MAPS[/h2]
You can create your own maps with the level editor and load them from this menu.
Or subscribe to Steam workshop items and see them listed here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=1482380&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems]LINK TO MANIAC WORKSHOP[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/7e082c0838f4c2b7205c1d6d79a4252053759c13.jpg[/img]

UPLOAD YOUR OWN CITY TO STEAM LIKE THIS
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/4c17e4fca60fbaef1d6dc73f0338aaca17f384d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]FLOATING POINTS![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/8047c2b239051023bb7c37b346e4a42efc210cd3.png[/img]
Floating points help you see what you've picked up and how much damage you have dealt (useful for score attack mode!)

DAMAGE - white
MONEY - green
AMMO - yellow
HEALTH -red

Floating points are optional and can be disabled in the game settings (they can affect performance).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/5760c49b12a2dd4087a5bc0d9ff2420d0aba699b.png[/img]

[b]Do you wanna nuke the city on hard mode!?[/b]

I tried to keep the normal game balanced for all. But for the hard core players I've made a special HARD mode.

Changes in hard mode:
* More pursuit vehicles
* Faster and more frequent enemy bullets
* Higher max damage (less health)
* Limited ammo
* Higher shop prices

[b]Hard mode is unlocked if you complete/nuke the city with all 6 characters.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/6e5574aaedd07667e8e566b0dd8decbfdd0a4607.png[/img]
Feel like going for an endless run? Do you want to compete against your highest score?

In the top right corner you'll find the new damage score indicator (only in Score Attack mode). The bar shows how much you have left until the next pursuit level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/3d9838444c5771dd7a9842291b4b5862fb6aff8d.png[/img]

Score attack doesn't have a time limit. Instead wanted levels come in based on the damage you've made to the city, cars and people (just like good old GTA 1).

[b]Score attack is unlocked if you complete/nuke the city with one character.[/b]

[h2]PLAYABLE MOMENTS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/ff6c1d36b9951a90d6dca63966875e74a8ff48e6.png[/img]
Last but not least. Playable moments allow you to play player created challenges. It works like a replay of a moment of gameplay. You can play the same moment and try to beat somebodies score. For instance, a playable moment objective might be to run over 20 policemen within a 15-second timeframe. You can do the same or out-do the creators score.

You can also sign-up, create and upload your own moments for others to play. If for whatever reason you decide to not use this feature, you can easily disable it in the Playable Moments settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43158517/0a30f1ac297491375390ba8fce3f17acf40e99d5.png[/img] (top-right corner)

notes.title: MANIAC - DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP
notes.content:
I've planned 2 content updates for Maniac in the upcoming few weeks:

UPDATE 1 (this week or next week)
[list]
[*] [b]Playable Moments[/b] - a new feature which enables anyone to replay anyone's moment during gameplay. This means you can save a highlight of your gameplay and then share that moment with the community. For example you destroyed 5 tanks in 30 seconds with Santa. You can let others replay that moment and let them beat your score - to destroy 7 tanks in 20 seconds - for example. More on this in the update!
[*] [b]Most critical bug fixes[/b] - auto-aim issues, controller issues, menus and upgrade issues.
[/list]

UPDATE 2 (in about 4-5 weeks)
This update will focus on the much missing Steam features content:
[list]
[*] [b]Steam Achievements[/b] - a lot of new stuff to do!
[*] [b]Steam Workshop[/b] - 

[olist]
[*] an easy way to play new maps created with the editor 
[*]ability to play modified pursuit levels (order and amount of pursuit vehicles)
[/olist]
[*] [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]
[*][b] New game modes
[/b]
[olist]
[*] [b]Hard Mode[/b] - available after beating the game with all characters 
[*] [b]Score Attack[/b] - pursuit levels come in based on damage not time
[/olist]
[/list]

MOST IMPORTANT UPCOMING BUG FIXES:
[list]
[*] Auto-fire and auto-aim fixes
[*] Menu bugs with controller
[*] Blue screen / tank physics bugs
[*] Most Wanted upgrade breaking the end game
[*] Auto-pickup issues
[*] Upgrades with high level of upgrade issues
[/list]

As far as the future goes... it depends on you!
I'm open to suggestions. Please be vocal on Discord and Steam forums. 
I'm reading and taking notes on what's coming next for Maniac!

Have fun!
MM
